summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce that its Board set October 21, 2026 as the date of the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, which will be held more than 30 days after the prior year's meeting. The filing establishes new deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations, requiring materials by August 16, 2026. This is a routine administrative notice regarding meeting logistics and proxy deadlines. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or event triggering a special-situation category is present. The filing contains no deal terms, financial consideration, or structural changes.
